subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades intentionally park legacy ownerless outbox rows for manual re-entry and deletion while migrating chat cache ownership from schema v4 to v8?
rationale: Tests establish the mechanics, but only maintainers can accept the user-facing upgrade tradeoff between preventing unsafe replay and preserving convenient retry of ambiguous queued messages.

options.title: Approve fail-closed migration
options.body: Accept the current manual-recovery contract after exact-head fresh-install and v4→v8 upgrade proof confirms rows remain visible and cannot replay under the wrong owner.

options.title: Add guided recovery
options.body: Keep owner-scoped replay but add a clearer in-app recovery action that lets users safely reconstruct or discard ambiguous rows before landing.

options.title: Split durable migration
options.body: Land a narrower transient composer fix and move cache/outbox schema migration into a separately reviewed Android storage change.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Accept the current manual-recovery contract after exact-head fresh-install and v4→v8 upgrade proof confirms rows remain visible and cannot replay under the wrong owner.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the final owner architecture and migration implementation and is the strongest available owner for accepting or revising its upgrade contract.
